name: LongNoseDog (LONG)
rootCause: LongNoseDog (LONG) on BSC is suspected of a rug pull, with the deployer removing substantial liquidity, causing a 100% price decline.

descriptions.text: LongNoseDog (LONG) on BSC is suspected of a rug pull, with the deployer removing substantial liquidity, causing a 100% price decline.

LongNoseDog (LONG), a meme token on BNB Chain, was reported as a rug pull on 2024-01-18 after the deployer allegedly removed PancakeSwap liquidity and swapped LONG tokens for roughly 998.7 BNB. Public reporting estimated losses near $310,000, but primary transaction evidence and the token contract were not independently verified from the available records. Available reporting indicates that the LONG deployer retained effective control over the PancakeSwap liquidity position and used that control to withdraw liquidity and sell tokens into the market. No independently verified smart contract vulnerability or PancakeSwap flaw has been established in the available evidence.
